node.statement: For every amplification level q>=1, use tilde-Delta_q tilde-Upsilon_q=tilde-Phi_q from lem-routef-raw-factor-identities to write Delta_q Upsilon_q-Phi_q=(Delta_q-tilde-Delta_q)Upsilon_q+tilde-Delta_q(Upsilon_q-tilde-Upsilon_q)+(tilde-Phi_q-Phi_q).  The triangle inequality and submultiplicativity, followed by the estimates established in the preceding two steps, give ||Delta_q Upsilon_q-Phi_q|| <= (C_Delta*eta)*1+2*(C_Upsilon*eta)+C_theta*eta=(C_theta+C_Delta+2*C_Upsilon)*eta.  Taking the supremum over q proves ||Delta Upsilon-Phi||_cb <= (C_theta+C_Delta+2*C_Upsilon)*eta.
